summary: Build-time ReDoS check: every regex LITERAL in src/ and hooks/ (found via the TypeScript AST) is run through the recheck analyser; exponential or degree>=3 polynomial fails, quadratic passes only if recheck's own worst input at 20KB (QUADRATIC_PROBE_LEN) stays under QUADRATIC_BUDGET_MS (2s). Runtime `new RegExp(...)` patterns are invisible to it — e.g. gs --match /re/ in src/server/tools.ts compileMatchPredicate, the glob builders in src/indexer/rust-workspace.ts and src/indexer/resolvers/index.ts, and hooks/evidence.mjs / recall-query.mjs / ignore.mjs. Runs inside npm test, so CI blocks merges on it; it costs ~10-20s per run.
